about: Pusatier, Abbott, Sugarman & Martin, LLP works from Elmwood Avenue, says it has served Western New York since 1976, and names four attorneys. Its front door presents divorce mediation beside personal injury, and its family work is where it enters this ranking.

33 reviews at 4.6. Its domain redirects to pasmlaw.com, which is the site measured here. It describes three routes through a case, including a collaborative process, and its site scores 36 out of 100, second lowest in this ranking, with a largest contentful paint of 15.4 seconds. Its pages carry contingency language, which Rule 1.5(d)(5)(i) forbids in a domestic relations matter, and that is recorded for a person to read rather than scored: a firm with an injury practice may well be describing that one.
